_description: 4×4 toy grid. Every cell is 1 km². All 16 cells are valid (no nodata). 5 cells are selected. Expected values are computed by hand and serve as ground truth for both Python and future JavaScript parity tests.

full_layer._description: All cells present. Overlap with selected = all 5 selected cells.

top_half._description: Only rows 0–1 are present. Selected cells in those rows: (0,2),(0,3),(1,1),(1,2) = 4 cells.

unselected_only._description: Layer covers exactly the 11 unselected cells. Overlap with selected = 0.
